description: This PHP source file defines an API class 'LocalizationAPI' for managing localization settings within an admin plugin of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides endpoints to retrieve and update localization configurations such as language and date format, leveraging traits and services for configuration and localization functionalities. The class implements CRUD interface methods, with only 'getOne' and 'update' operational, and other methods throwing 'not implemented' exceptions.

classes.name: LocalizationAPI
classes.description: A REST API class providing localized settings retrieval and update endpoints for administration within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Returns current default language and date format configurations.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the default language and date format configurations based on request input.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' method, excluding 'id' parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'update' method, validating 'language' and 'dateFormat' parameters.
